positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of OpenSAF development team.

Member of OpenSAF TLC (Technical Leadership Committee) responsible for technical direction of OpenSAF. I work with members from Ericsson, Oracle, and HP.

Maintainer of PLM, MSG, CKPT, and LCK services for OpenSAF.

Implemented virtualization for PLM using libvirt.
